title: The Plus Sign

canonical_node.axiom: Reality requires exactly three distinct functions in one unified operation to close the measurement regress.
definitions: Plus sign: the operation that connects two things and produces a third thing that did not exist before.
Actualization: the operation that makes one possibility into one actuality, irreversibly, at a cost.
G (Generator): forward-facing, possibility; physically unitary evolution.
L (Logos/Selector): boundary, structure; physically basis selection.
A (Actualizer): backward-facing, record; physically thermodynamic irreversibility.
Triadic composition: three functions in one operation, internally unified, not an external chain.
derivation: 1+1=2 involves three things: two objects and a plus sign that acts.
General relativity faces forward (possibility); quantum mechanics faces backward (actuality).
They meet at the present, a zero-width boundary.
Actualization at that boundary is irreversible and costs energy (Landauer).
One function cannot both generate and collapse (reversible vs irreversible).
Two functions regress because the collapser needs its own collapser.
Three separate functions regress because they need a coordinator.
No collapse at all abandons the question.
Only three functions in one operation terminates the regress without external verifier.
canonical_node.action: Adopt the triadic composition T = A  L  G as the structural core for interpreting measurement and unification.
boundary: Does not prove the Christian Trinity true by physics alone.
Does not provide a testable prediction distinguishing from standard QM interpretations.
Does not extend from Boolean model to infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.
Does not derive the Born rule from Landauer cost.
test: Check that any non-triadic structure (monadic, dyadic, quaternary) fails to terminate the measurement regress under the same definitions.
Verify the nine Lean 4 theorems compile without errors or sorry.
Attempt to find a counterexample where a non-triadic structure closes the chain.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a structural argument that triadic composition is necessary to close the measurement regress, with machine-verified Boolean model.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the standard quantum measurement formalism and the irreversibility of actualization.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the triadic composition is removed, the measurement regress remains open and no alternative closure is provided.

classification.recommended_atom_action: archive as structural hypothesis with machine-checked Boolean model; flag as not yet extended to full QM

overstatement_risks: Claiming the Trinity is proven by physics
Claiming the Boolean model extends to Hilbert space
Claiming the derivation is independent of interpretation when it relies on specific assumptions
kill_conditions: A non-triadic structure that terminates the measurement regress without regress or contradiction
Failure of the Lean 4 theorems to compile in a corrected model
Demonstration that the Boolean model is not representative of quantum mechanics
risk.lean_target: Formalize the triadic closure theorem in Lean 4 for a more general model, or find a counterexample.

plain_summary: The document argues that the measurement problem in quantum mechanics requires a triadic structure - three functions in one operation - to avoid infinite regress. It claims machine verification in a Boolean model but acknowledges the extension to real quantum mechanics is open. The identification with the Christian Trinity is a metaphysical bridge, not a proof.
